priority_order: 1. EN exact match (station_id in line.stations, case-sensitive)
2. JP exact match (name_map JP key -> EN value)
4. JP partial match (substring in name_map JP key)

known_limitations.16_NOT_FOUND: Entity-only stations with no route connection
known_limitations.1383_orphan_refs: Station IDs in line.stations without entity

rules.no_data_modification: railway_data.json must never be modified by business code
rules.no_second_database: All business code must use RailwayDB -> DataLayer chain
rules.entity_preservation: New canonical must not reduce entity counts without manifest
